item.title: MG Pakistan and JW SEZ Introduce SGMW Binguo EV — The Electric Icon
item.description: MG Pakistan, in collaboration with JW SEZ, has announced the introduction of the SGMW Binguo EV, a B‑segment hatchback developed by SAIC‑GM‑Wuling (SGMW).
